<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Language status:</strong> The Supreme Court is examining the constitutional status of the English language in India during hearings regarding the CBSE&#x27;s three-language policy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Political discourse:</strong> The Congress party faces internal unease and external criticism from the BJP regarding its stance on &#x27;Vande Mataram&#x27; and alleged misinformation campaigns.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W19</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a></span></li>
